info.name: NormaOne – Auth, Onboarding, Packages & RBAC
info.description: Run in order. See docs/AUTH_RBAC_GUIDE.md section 8 (invitations: section 7). Login requests store the ID token in a collection variable (tenantAdminToken / userToken / superAdminToken). Browsers get the session as HttpOnly cookies; this collection asks for the tokens in the body (X-Token-Delivery: body) and sends Authorization: Bearer. Every /api/auth request carries X-Requested-With (CSRF). The invited user signs in with the temporary password Cognito emailed them: copy it into userTemporaryPassword before folder 4. No password is ever returned by the API. Folder 6 covers notifications (docs section 10); attachments are sent as multipart/form-data with a "notification" JSON part and an "attachment" file part. Folder 5 also covers Super Admin invitations, the account directory and administrators' module access (docs sections 11-12); folder 7 covers the module catalog and plans (docs sections 11 and 13).

item.name: My modules (GET /api/users/me: six modules, every permission for the owner)

exec: pm.test('the owner who registered holds every permission, DELETE included', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().modulePermissions).to.include('PREVENWORK_DELETE'));

item.name: A user's modules (six, VIEW by default)
Set one module (JornadaPulse: view + clock in)
Give a permission beyond the defaults (PrevenWork with erasure)

exec: pm.test('the user now holds the erasure', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().modules.find(m => m.moduleId === 'PREVENWORK').permissions).to.include('PREVENWORK_DELETE'));

Login with the temporary password (stores challengeSession)
My modules as a user (VIEW in each module)

Admins with the tenant admin token (expect 403)

exec: pm.test('platform account, invited', () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.role).to.eql('SUPER_ADMIN'); pm.expect(b.status).to.eql('INVITED'); pm.expect(b).to.not.have.property('tenantId'); });

item.name: 7. Modules and plans (docs sections 11-13)
item.description: The static module catalog, a tenant admin's effective modules, and plan management. Run folder 5 first (superAdminToken, tenantId, adminId). No payment is taken by any of these requests.

Move the tenant back to BASIC
8. Plan requests, plan history and audit (docs sections 13-14)
Offer PRO to Tenant Admins (metadata of a published plan)

exec: pm.test('PRO can be requested', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().find(p => p.id === pm.collectionVariables.get('planId')).selectable).to.eql(true));

pm.test('pending, for the own organization', () => { const r = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(r.status).to.eql('PENDING'); pm.expect(r.organization.id).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('tenantId')); });
